topic_title: Value of Responsible Reduced-Risk Driving Practices
prompt: What is the single most effective habit a driver can maintain to prevent multi-vehicle pileups?

options.text: Maintain an adequate following interval and preserve open space around vehicle
Drive ten miles per hour faster than surrounding traffic to avoid being hit
Sound vehicle horn every two miles to maintain surrounding driver alertness
Change lanes continuously to find the absolute fastest moving traffic corridor
